title: Min Stack: Every Pancake Knows the Smallest Below
summary: Each pancake carries a note of the smallest size at or below it, so the minimum is always on top and a pop restores the old one for free.

analogy.scenario: A cook stacks pancakes of different sizes and can only take the top one. Each pancake carries a sticky note with its size and the smallest size at or below it, so the smallest in the stack is always written on the top note.

takeaway.summary: Push (value, min(value, the minimum under it)). The top pair always holds the current minimum, and popping a pair restores the previous one.
whenToUse: A stack that must also report its minimum (or maximum) in O(1)
State that depends only on what's below each element

scenes.narration: A cook stacks pancakes and can only take the top one. Diners keep asking for the smallest pancake in the stack, and every answer must be instant.
scenes.caption: Stacked pancakes: which is the smallest, without unstacking?

scenes.narration: Checking every pancake is O(n), and a single note saying which is smallest goes stale when that pancake is taken. Instead, each pancake's note records the smallest at or below it, so the top note answers in O(1).
scenes.caption: Scanning is O(n); one note breaks when that pancake leaves

scenes.narration: The first pancake is size 6, so its note reads 6 and 6.
scenes.caption: The first pancake, size 6, is the smallest so far: (6, 6)

scenes.narration: Next comes 2, smaller than the 6 noted below it, so this note records a new smallest: 2.
scenes.caption: A size-2 pancake is smaller than 6: its note says 2

scenes.narration: Then 8, bigger than 2, so its note copies the smallest from below: 8 and 2.
scenes.caption: A size-8 pancake isn't smaller: its note keeps 2

scenes.narration: Asking for the smallest just reads the top note: 2, in constant time.
scenes.caption: getMin(): read the top note, 2, with no search

scenes.narration: The 8 comes off, then the 2 itself. Nothing is recomputed: the note underneath was written before 2 arrived, and it says 6.
scenes.caption: The size-2 pancake leaves; the note below already says 6

scenes.narration: So the last getMin reads 6 straight off the top.
scenes.caption: getMin(): the top note now says 6

scenes.narration: In code, each pancake is a pair of value and minimum so far. push, pop, top, and getMin are all O(1), using O(n) space for the pairs.
scenes.caption: Each pair is (value, min so far): every call is O(1)
